title: Time Zone Conversion
instructions: Use the `zoneinfo` module to convert a specific time from London to Tokyo time.
steps: Define the London time zone object: `london_tz = ZoneInfo('Europe/London')`.
Create an aware datetime object for 9:00 AM on July 10, 2025, in the London time zone. Store it in `london_meeting`.
Define the Tokyo time zone object: `tokyo_tz = ZoneInfo('Asia/Tokyo')`.
Use the `.astimezone()` method to convert `london_meeting` to Tokyo time. Store the result in `tokyo_meeting`.
Print the hour of `tokyo_meeting` to verify the time shift.
starterCode:
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

# 1. Define London Time Zone
london_tz = ZoneInfo('Europe/London')

# 2. Create the aware datetime (July 10, 2025, 9:00 AM London)
london_meeting = datetime(2025, 7, 10, 9, 0, 0, tzinfo=london_tz)

# 3. Define Tokyo Time Zone
tokyo_tz = ZoneInfo('Asia/Tokyo')

# 4. Convert London time to Tokyo time
tokyo_meeting = ...

# 5. Print the hour in Tokyo
print(tokyo_meeting.hour)
solution:
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

# 1. Define London Time Zone
london_tz = ZoneInfo('Europe/London')

# 2. Create the aware datetime (July 10, 2025, 9:00 AM London)
london_meeting = datetime(2025, 7, 10, 9, 0, 0, tzinfo=london_tz)

# 3. Define Tokyo Time Zone
tokyo_tz = ZoneInfo('Asia/Tokyo')

# 4. Convert London time to Tokyo time
tokyo_meeting = london_meeting.astimezone(tokyo_tz)

# 5. Print the hour in Tokyo
print(tokyo_meeting.hour)
hints: In July, London is on British Summer Time (BST, UTC+1). Tokyo is UTC+9. The shift is 8 hours ahead.
The `.astimezone()` method takes the target time zone object as its only argument.
